items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: I've got a buggy whip that was my grandfather's from Wild Bill Hickock

ctx.x: In conclusion, Milt, for now, the last few years of concerts and credits, I think when we get together, after looking over the notes that I have, you and I can cover some of the things, if you're interested in my hobbies and my vast collection of antiques and guns and knives and bayonets, sword collections, my Civil War replicas and relics, and well, not replicas - I have some original relics, and bullets from the major battlefields from the War of the States, and I have a 13 star flag, which went down

with our troops from Maine, in the Battle of -- oh, Lord, I don't know which one off hand, I've got a buggy whip that was my grandfather's from Wild Bill Hickock, Buffalo Bill, that is; and I have many valuable antique trinkets and collections -- a lot of them came from my aunt from the early 1800's. A lot of these things are from my family.

I don't know what anything is worth, because I've never had an expert evaluate my complete collections, but if you want to get into that later on, I'd be more than happy if you think it's of any interest to this article -- because of my cataract operations in 1963 and so on ...
